clauses.clause_label: Prior written permission required; unauthorized use prohibited
clauses.actor_role: person or entity seeking to use the Software
clauses.scope_note: Applies to the Software and associated documentation identified as Mindra Inc.'s Software. Use, copying, modification, merging, publishing/distribution, sublicensing, and sale of copies are prohibited absent prior written permission from Mindra Inc.; the text does not specify the terms or scope of any permission granted.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when prior written permission from Mindra Inc. has not been obtained.

coverage_notes: The supplied text contains no affirmative grant; it does not establish permission for activities if written permission is granted or specify any such permission's terms.
The warranty disclaimer and ownership statements are not operative ASC clauses.
